summary: AFS SenSub Corp., as depositor, and AmeriCredit Financial Services (GM Financial), as sponsor, caused GM Financial Consumer Automobile Receivables Trust 2026-4 to issue $1.0158 billion of asset-backed notes on October 14, 2026, across Class A-1 (4.258%), A-2-A (4.78%), floating-rate A-2-B, A-3 (5.26%), A-4 (5.36%), B (5.54%) and C (5.64%) tranches plus an asset-backed certificate. The 8-K satisfies an undertaking to file executed transaction agreements; collateral is prime auto loan receivables. SMBC Nikko is representative underwriter. This is a routine ABS shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch spread clearing and collateral performance.
